scripts.build: node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && node scripts/check-test-environment-config.mjs && tsc -b && npm run build -w @bickr/web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:workers && npm run deploy:web
scripts.deploy:workers: npm run deploy -w @bickr/forum-coordinator && npm run deploy -w @bickr/agent-runtime
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build && npm run migrate:test && npm run deploy:test:workers && npm run deploy:test:web
scripts.deploy:test:workers: npm run deploy:test -w @bickr/forum-coordinator && npm run deploy:test -w @bickr/agent-runtime
scripts.migrate:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply BICKR_D1 --remote --config workers/forum-coordinator/wrangler.jsonc --env test
